_about: The System section of Settings, one entry per panel, in the order the section lists them. A panel is a module in this folder with status(run) and ACTIONS {name: fn(body, run)}; adding one is one module plus one entry here. "keywords" are extra words the Settings search finds the panel by. "reset" names the group in ../reset_groups.json that the panel's own reset button at its foot runs.

panels.label: Auto-close
panels.about: Close apps when RAM is high or they have not been used for a while. The RAM guard service does the closing.
panels.keywords: ram memory auto close idle unused guard kill

panels.label: Sound
panels.about: Output and input devices and their volume (PipeWire, through pactl).
panels.keywords: audio volume speaker headphones microphone mic mute output input

panels.label: Bluetooth
panels.about: Scan, pair, connect and disconnect devices (bluetoothctl).
panels.keywords: bluetooth pair connect headphones buds devices

panels.label: Wi-Fi
panels.about: Networks in range and saved ones (NetworkManager, through nmcli).
panels.keywords: wifi wireless network internet password hotspot

panels.label: Display
panels.about: Screen brightness and GNOME's night light.
panels.keywords: screen brightness night light warmth colour temperature

panels.label: Battery
panels.about: Battery and charger. CPU caps and power profiles live in the Power app.

panels.label: Notifications
panels.about: Do not disturb: GNOME stops showing notification banners.
panels.keywords: notifications do not disturb dnd banners lock screen

panels.label: Date and time
panels.about: The clock, time zone and network time. Read-only.
panels.keywords: date time clock time zone ntp
